scope: Authenticated Posts and Replies traversal plus year-bounded incoming mention search, reconciled to the 434-record live profile counter.

protectedInputs.populationSchema: Authenticated capture containing profile, traversal, rows, and excluded conversation context.
protectedInputs.populationIdSetDigestAlgorithm: SHA-256 of unique status IDs sorted lexicographically and joined with a newline, without a terminal newline.
protectedInputs.incomingSchema: Authenticated year-bounded search capture containing query, year summary, and recovered rows.
protectedInputs.incomingIdSetDigestAlgorithm: SHA-256 of unique status IDs sorted lexicographically and joined with a newline, without a terminal newline.
protectedInputs.stakeholderDispositionSchema: One protected statusId, authorHandle, classification, and stakeholderGroup record for every incoming row.
protectedInputs.stakeholderDispositionsDigestAlgorithm: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted canonical JSON after sorting records by statusId.

classifier.manifestDigestAlgorithm: SHA-256 of recursively key-sorted canonical JSON.

publicOutput.privacyContract: The public fixture must satisfy the exact allowed-key schema and cannot contain row-level status, text, handle, date, link, session, contact, or local-path fields.

verification.reproducibilityBoundary: The command is intentionally runnable only by an authorized reviewer with the three protected inputs. It proves the checked-in aggregate from protected rows without copying the personal timeline into the public repository.
